title: Sennacherib’s second invasion
summary: Jones dates Sennacherib’s second invasion, as pro-rex.
description: Jones dates Sennacherib’s second invasion, as pro-rex. The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed. Kevin ruled (2026-10-27) that this is not the 713 BC invasion on sennacherib-besieges-jerusalem.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 709 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 279 (PDF p. 314)
chronologies.note: Distinct from sennacherib-besieges-jerusalem (Jones's 713 BC first invasion, as Tartan). The angel who slays 185,000 is the next Appendix F line, on angel-slays-the-assyrians.
